Online Data builds and operates Habitat, the single product surface of Online Data and the system of record for OpenAI’s online user data. As OpenAI’s scale and product requirements evolve, Habitat is becoming a full-stack, one-size-fits-most database platform with end-to-end ownership of:

- Provisioning and developer experience

- APIs and guardrails

- Scaling, performance, and reliability

- Data movement, caching, routing, and placement

- Privacy enforcement and access control

- Change Data Capture (CDC) as a first-class primitive

- The foundation for future storage backends

You’ll work on the core online database platform behind OpenAI’s products, building and operating Habitat services that handle high-QPS, latency-sensitive workloads across regions. You’ll partner closely with internal platform and product teams to ship safe, reliable systems, then push them to be faster and more cost-efficient through better caching, routing, observability, and operational tooling. This is a critical role for engineers who like owning hard distributed-systems problems end to end and sweating the details from p99 latency to production operations at massive scale.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Design and build core abstractions spanning storage, caching, routing, CDC, and privacy enforcement

- Own a major surface area end to end, from product and API design to operational excellence

- Improve latency, correctness, and cost efficiency for real production workloads at massive scale

- Build strong instrumentation, debugging workflows, and developer-first tooling

- Collaborate closely with internal product and infrastructure teams to understand requirements and ship pragmatic solutions

- Participate in an on-call rotation and raise the bar on reliability while aggressively improving performance and usability

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

- A strong track record building and operating high-scale backend or data-intensive distributed systems in production

- Excellent systems judgment and the ability to make tradeoffs across latency, cost, correctness, and reliability

- Deep care for developer experience: simple abstractions, strong defaults, guardrails, and debuggability

- Comfort owning ambiguous problems end to end and driving roadmap plus execution

- Experience in one or more of: databases, caching systems, routing and load balancing, indexing and retrieval, CDC pipelines

- Deep experience with tail latency and global performance optimization (p95, p99, request steering, locality)

- Experience designing platform APIs consumed by many internal teams

- Experience with multi-region systems, consistency semantics, and failover design

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of industry experience building production software, including 3+ years leading large-scale, complex projects or technical initiatives as a tech lead or senior IC

- Strong passion for building distributed systems at scale, with a focus on reliability, scalability, security, and continuous improvement

- Proficiency in Rust and/or Python (Rust preferred for core systems work; Python commonly used for tooling, services, and ecosystem integration)

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build alignment and drive decisions across diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Driven and motivated to learn and execute Cell Therapy Manufacturing operations

• 4+ years of experience in cGMP bioprocessing manufacturing, cell therapy manufacturing or relevant experience.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking a candidate to drive our strategic Amazon/AWS partnership. You'll own this partnership end-to-end — building executive relationships across both organizations, developing joint go-to-market strategy, and generating large-scale revenue opportunities through AWS's ecosystem.

In this role, you'll help shape how frontier AI technology is commercialized at scale, and you'll build the playbook for what a successful AI-cloud provider partnership looks like at Anthropic.

Key responsibilities

• Develop and execute go-to-market strategy for our AWS partnership, including co-selling motions, enablement programs, and joint business plans
• Build pipeline forecasting and track progress against shared revenue targets
• Build and maintain executive-level relationships across the AWS organization
• Drive strategic planning and execution of joint marketing and sales initiatives
• Design scalable processes for partnership operations, including escalation management and reporting
• Design and execute segment-specific sales plays and enablement programs
• Represent Anthropic in joint business reviews with key stakeholders
• Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to inform product and business strategy
• Identify and develop opportunities to expand the scope and impact of the partnership

Minimum qualifications

• Demonstrated experience building and scaling co-sell or joint go-to-market motions with a major cloud provider or technology platform partner
• Experience building partnership forecasting, pipeline tracking, and reporting processes (e.g., in Salesforce or a comparable CRM)
• Experience negotiating and structuring joint business plans with external partners
• Experience translating technical product capabilities into business value for enterprise or partner audiences
• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time

Preferred qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, or partnerships
• Previous experience working directly with Amazon/AWS partner or alliance teams
• Background in AI/ML technologies or enterprise software
• Experience scaling partnerships in emerging technology markets
• Track record of building enterprise GTM strategies from the ground up
• Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence with senior stakeholders across organizations

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$300,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. About the Team

DashMart Kitchens (DMK) is a dedicated culinary team operating within a shared DashMart facility. While we work inside a DashMart building, we are a specialized team focused on preparing high-quality meals for customers ordering through the DoorDash app.

We work side-by-side with our DashMart partners to deliver a seamless customer experience — supporting both kitchen execution and shared facility standards. We operate as one team within four walls, collaborating to ensure operational excellence, food quality, and a clean, organized environment.

Shifts: Morning, Day, Evening, Weekend, Part-Time

About the Role

As a Kitchen Operations Associate, you are responsible for preparing meals to standard, maintaining kitchen and warehouse organization, and supporting order fulfillment within a shared facility environment.

What You’ll Do:

Meal Preparation & Quality

• Prepare and assemble menu items according to brand and food safety standards
• Ensure every meal meets quality, accuracy, and presentation standards before handoff
• Follow all food safety, cleanliness, and dress code compliance guidelines

Warehouse & Kitchen Organization

• Maintain organized dry, refrigerated, and frozen storage areas
• Follow cleanliness and sanitation standards across shared workspaces
• Support inventory organization and proper product rotation (FIFO)

Facility Support

• Collaborate with DashMart Operations Associates to maintain a cohesive and efficient site
• Assist with light operational tasks as needed to support overall facility success
• Uphold a “One Team” mindset to create a positive experience for all team members and customers

You're excited about this opportunity because...

• You enjoy working with food and have a passion for culinary execution and quality while maintaining food safety
• You want to be part of a dedicated kitchen team operating within a fast-paced fulfillment environment
• Market competitive pay (10pm–6am will receive a $2 increase in pay)
• AM/PM/Overnight shifts available
• Opportunity for pay increases twice a year based upon performance
• Paid time off (PTO) and sick leave
• Gym membership reimbursement (up to $75/month)
• Monthly DashPass subscription (including access to Lyft discounts for full-time employees)
• Employee Assistance Program
• Career advancement opportunities

We're excited about you because...

• You’re reliable, positive, and team-oriented
• You have experience in food service (fast food and quick-service restaurants), grocery, or beverage operations, or a willingness to learn
• You’re detail-oriented and passionate about fresh food quality and safety
• You can lift up to 50 lbs and work in refrigerated areas (with or without accommodation)
• You have a high school diploma or GED
• You’re willing to complete a Food Handler’s Certification upon hire
